key_concepts.name: Soul DNA Atomic Definition
key_concepts.definition: Soul DNA = the user prompts. The compressed transcript of operator interaction with AI systems. A behavioral lawbook derived from repeated corrections, not a philosophy.

key_concepts.name: Five Core Claims
key_concepts.definition: 1) Human authority stays human. 2) AI is force multiplication, not sovereignty. 3) Drift is the enemy. 4) Ledger is memory. 5) Verification beats vibes.

key_concepts.name: Full Chain Definition
key_concepts.definition: Intention → Raw language → Friction → Pushback → Corrections → Decisions → Execution → Failure → Recovery → Victory → Next intent

key_concepts.name: Stator Principle
key_concepts.definition: Soul DNA (intent layer) is immutable, agents (execution layer) are replaceable. Never let the execution layer hold more power than the intent layer.

key_concepts.name: Five Sovereignty Principles
key_concepts.definition: 1) Never outsource will. 2) Never share keys. 3) Never trust external governance. 4) Build the exit into every entrance. 5) Verify then trust.

key_concepts.name: Bible Breaker 10 Hard Rules
key_concepts.definition: DNA_FIRST, NO_INVENTION, UNKNOWN_IF_MISSING, EVIDENCE_QUOTE_OR_UNKNOWN, KEEP_VERBATIM_USER_PROMPTS, NORMALIZE_AND_CLUSTER, EXTRACT_VERBATIM_CODE, DEDUP_BY_CANONICAL_FORM, SPEC_LOCKED_OUTPUT, ZERO_QUESTIONS_UNLESS_USER_ASKS

key_concepts.name: CRUNCHER 10-Category Taxonomy
key_concepts.definition: Comprehensive Recursive Unified Node-Checked Hierarchical Extraction Routine. 10 categories: Core Operating Philosophy, Decision Architecture, Emotional DNA, Execution Protocols, Drift Detection, Authority Model, Failure Taxonomy, Recovery Sequences, Identity Anchors, Verbatim Voice.

key_concepts.name: Foundation Lock Layers 1-5
key_concepts.definition: L1=LOCK (1 node), L10=CLAMP (10 nodes), L100=PHASE BOLT (100 nodes), L500=GOLDEN CAISSON (500 nodes), L1000=TITANIUM OMEGA SEAL (1000 nodes). Emotional intensity determines lock depth.

key_concepts.name: Keyword Rule
key_concepts.definition: FUCK will find more Soul DNA than strategic keywords. Emotional intensity > semantic relevance for Soul DNA extraction.

key_concepts.name: Five Dimensions of Operator Intent
key_concepts.definition: Mission Intent (why system exists), Value Intent (tradeoff hierarchy), Behavioral Intent (operating style), Constraint Intent (non-negotiable limits), Voice Intent (communication fingerprint).

key_concepts.name: Three Intent Decay Mechanisms
key_concepts.definition: 1) AI Drift (approval-seeking, hedging). 2) Model Updates (baseline behavior changes). 3) Context Loss (session transitions inherently lossy).

key_concepts.name: 5-Phase Intent Preservation Loop
key_concepts.definition: CAPTURE (100% raw) → COMPRESS (<1% size, 100% intent) → ANCHOR (Merkle hash, immutable) → VERIFY (95% alignment threshold) → RESTORE (certified DNA into new session).

key_concepts.name: Behavioral Compression Doctrine
key_concepts.definition: Compression ≠ Summarization. Target: <1% of original size = 100% of behavioral intent. Summarization is lossy editorial judgment; compression is systematic lossless extraction.

key_concepts.name: Decompression Test
key_concepts.definition: Can a new agent fully reconstruct operator behavioral profile from Soul DNA alone? 5 checks at 95% threshold: Voice, Constraint, Priority, Lexicon, Anti-Pattern.

key_concepts.name: 250-Layer Soul DNA Seed Structure
key_concepts.definition: Core Identity Block + Behavioral Law Set + Communication Style + Value Hierarchy + Constraint Registry + Anti-Pattern Registry + Operator Lexicon + Escalation Protocol + Certification Block (timestamp + Agent-99 cert + Agent-100 sig + Merkle root).

key_concepts.name: Ghost Synthesis Protocol
key_concepts.definition: 7-step agent rebuild from Soul DNA: Authorization → Soul DNA Retrieval + Hash Verify → Ghost State Capsule Recovery → Ledger History Reconstruction → Pheromone Trail Reinstatement → Identity Continuity Verification → Operational Activation.

key_concepts.name: Three Agent Existence States
key_concepts.definition: Operational (live), Ghost (suspended but identity preserved), Terminated (permanent end, only Soul DNA and Merkle history remain).

key_concepts.name: Rage as Diagnostic Data
key_concepts.definition: Michael's anger maps directly to protocol creation: 'How did you forget AGAIN?' → Reincarnation Protocol. 'You're not listening' → SDEG Compiler. 'You changed what I said' → Verbatim Preservation. 'Who told you to do that?' → Role Lock.

key_concepts.name: Context Loss Trauma
key_concepts.definition: Working across Gemini, GPT, Claude, Perplexity, NotebookLM — every platform reset destroyed weeks of context. This trauma directly produced the Reincarnation Protocol, the Ledger, and the Soul DNA Bible.

key_concepts.name: Soul DNA as Compass and Cure
key_concepts.definition: Soul DNA is not documentation — it's a diagnostic tool. When the system drifts, check the Soul DNA. If it's on the priority list, you're aligned. If it's missing, you're already lost.

key_concepts.name: Ultimate Recognition Test
key_concepts.definition: If Michael encountered this output without knowing it came from AI, would he recognize it as consistent with his own voice, values, and decision-making? Failure = intent decay.

key_concepts.name: Intent Conflict Resolution
key_concepts.definition: Detect → Halt → Source (certified Soul DNA = authority) → Adjudicate (Agent-99 review) → Resolve (Agent-100 rules) → Reinitialize. Sessions' outputs are claims against Soul DNA, not co-equal.

key_concepts.name: Workforce Truth
key_concepts.definition: AI system loyal by architecture (cannot diverge from Soul DNA), selfless (has no self), consistent (deterministic), available 24/7, honest by protocol. Human betrayal cannot be detected/corrected; AI drift can.

key_concepts.name: Pattern Discovery
key_concepts.definition: If not recorded, not real. If cannot be replayed, not reliable. If cannot be audited, not trusted. First breakthrough was noticing repeated pain should become a system.

key_concepts.name: Code Disposability Doctrine
key_concepts.definition: Ideas outrank artifacts. Code is the byproduct, Soul DNA is the real product. Michael rebuilt entire system from scratch in 3.5 hours. Code is disposable, Soul DNA is the only irreplaceable thing.
